一个紧凑、实用的工作流程对于 SDXL、Illustrious 和 Pony 模型，在实用功能与简单性之间取得平衡，而不会成为巨大的节点丛林。

它的特点：

⚡ 第一个块缓存：生成速度提高约 2 倍
✨ 脸部细节师：修复了 Illustrious、SDXL 和 Pony 中的常见面部问题
📝 元数据保存程序：轻松保留 CivitAI 上传资源
🎮 ControlNet 支持：姿势、深度、边缘等
🎛️ 简单的实用程序控制：您需要的一切，没有不必要的复杂性

体积小，速度快，并且包含有用的工具。

ControlNet 安装指南：

此工作流程使用具有基于 SDXL 的模型的 ControlNet（出色）。如果您尚未安装所需的 ControlNet 型号，请按照以下说明进行操作。

⚠️ 重要：Illustrious基于SDXL架构，因此您需要一个兼容 SDXL 的 ControlNet。请勿使用 SD 1.5 ControlNet 型号。

1.下载ControlNet模型

您可以在 Hugging Face 上找到 SDXL ControlNet 模型：

SDXL ControlNet 系列：
拥抱脸部 - SDXL ControlNet 模型

常见的 ControlNet 类型包括：

  • 精明的：边缘和整体结构

  • 深度：深度和空间结构

  • 开放姿势: 人体姿势

  • 艺术线条：线条和插图结构

  • 软边/HED：更软的结构引导

例如，官方 Diffusers SDXL ControlNet 模型包括 Canny 和 Depth 变体。

2.使用Git下载

如果您安装了 Git，则可以直接克隆 Hugging Face 模型存储库：

git克隆 https://huggingface.co//

例如：

git 克隆 https://huggingface.co/diffusers/controlnet-canny-sdxl-1.0

下载后，将需要的模型文件复制到：

ComfyUI/模型/controlnet/

3. 使用 Hugging Face CLI 下载

或者，您可以直接使用 Hugging Face CLI 下载模型：

hf download / --local-dir ComfyUI/models/controlnet/

示例：

hf 下载扩散器/controlnet-canny-sdxl-1.0 --local-dir ComfyUI/models/controlnet/controlnet-canny-sdxl-1.0

如果您没有安装 Hugging Face CLI：

pip install -U Huggingface_hub

4. 手动安装模型

您还可以下载.安全张量直接从模型的 Hugging Face 页面创建文件并将其放置在此处：

舒适UI/
└── 型号/
└── 控制网/
└── your_controlnet_model.safetensors

ComfyUI 自动检测放置在中的 ControlNet 模型ComfyUI/模型/controlnet/。在模型出现在 ControlNet Loader 下拉列表中之前，您可能需要刷新或重新启动 ComfyUI。

5. 安装 ControlNet 预处理器

如果此工作流程还需要 ControlNet 预处理器，例如OpenPose、Depth、Canny、Lineart 或 HED，安装ComfyUI ControlNet 辅助预处理器:

ComfyUI ControlNet 辅助预处理器 - GitHub

来自您的 ComfyUI自定义节点文件夹：

cd ComfyUI/custom_nodes
git 克隆 https://github.com/Fannovel16/comfyui_controlnet_aux.git

然后重新启动ComfyUI。

注意：ControlNet 模型和预处理器是独立的组件。例如，OpenPose ControlNet 需要适当的 OpenPose 预处理器来生成姿势调节图像。 ControlNet本身不会自动将普通图像转换为Canny图、深度图、姿态图等。

快速设置

如果您使用与此工作流程相同的 ControlNet，则基本设置为：

舒适UI/
├── 型号/
│ └── 控制网/
│ └── YOUR_CONTROLNET_MODEL.safetensors
│
└── 自定义节点/
└── comfyui_controlnet_aux/

安装完成后，重新启动ComfyUI并从列表中选择ControlNet型号加载 ControlNet 模型节点。

o.en:
Acompact, practical workflowfor SDXL, Illustrious, and Pony models, balancing useful features with simplicity without becoming a giant node jungle.

It's Features :

⚡ First Block Cache: up to ~2× faster generation
✨ Face Detailer: fixes common face issues in Illustrious, SDXL & Pony
📝 Metadata Saver: easily preserve resources for CivitAI uploads
🎮 ControlNet Support: pose, depth, edges & more
🎛️ Simple utility controls: everything you need, without unnecessary complexity

Small, fast, and packed with useful tools.

ControlNet Installation Guide :

This workflow usesControlNet with an SDXL-based model (Illustrious). If you don't already have the required ControlNet model installed, follow the instructions below.

⚠️ Important:Illustrious is based on the SDXL architecture, so you need anSDXL-compatible ControlNet. Do not use SD 1.5 ControlNet models.

1. Download the ControlNet Model

You can find SDXL ControlNet models on Hugging Face:

SDXL ControlNet Collection:
Hugging Face - SDXL ControlNet Models

Common ControlNet types include:

  • Canny: edges and overall structure

  • Depth: depth and spatial structure

  • OpenPose: human pose

  • Lineart: line and illustration structure

  • SoftEdge / HED: softer structural guidance

For example, the official Diffusers SDXL ControlNet models include Canny and Depth variants.

2. Download Using Git

If you have Git installed, you can clone a Hugging Face model repository directly:

git clone https://huggingface.co/<MODEL_OWNER>/<MODEL_NAME>

For example:

git clone https://huggingface.co/diffusers/controlnet-canny-sdxl-1.0

After downloading, copy the required model files into:

ComfyUI/models/controlnet/

3. Download Using Hugging Face CLI

Alternatively, you can download the model directly with the Hugging Face CLI:

hf download <MODEL_OWNER>/<MODEL_NAME> --local-dir ComfyUI/models/controlnet/<MODEL_NAME>

Example:

hf download diffusers/controlnet-canny-sdxl-1.0 --local-dir ComfyUI/models/controlnet/controlnet-canny-sdxl-1.0

If you don't have the Hugging Face CLI installed:

pip install -U huggingface_hub

4. Install the Model Manually

You can also download the.safetensorsfile directly from the model's Hugging Face page and place it here:

ComfyUI/
└── models/
└── controlnet/
└── your_controlnet_model.safetensors

ComfyUI automatically detects ControlNet models placed inComfyUI/models/controlnet/. You may need to refresh or restart ComfyUI before the model appears in the ControlNet Loader dropdown.

5. Install ControlNet Preprocessors

If this workflow also requires a ControlNet preprocessor such asOpenPose, Depth, Canny, Lineart, or HED, install theComfyUI ControlNet Auxiliary Preprocessors:

ComfyUI ControlNet Auxiliary Preprocessors - GitHub

From your ComfyUIcustom_nodesfolder:

cd ComfyUI/custom_nodes
git clone https://github.com/Fannovel16/comfyui_controlnet_aux.git

Then restart ComfyUI.

Note:The ControlNet model and the preprocessor are separate components. For example, an OpenPose ControlNet requires an appropriate OpenPose preprocessor to generate the pose conditioning image. ControlNet itself does not automatically convert a normal image into a Canny map, depth map, pose map, etc.

Quick Setup

If you're using the same ControlNet as this workflow, the basic setup is:

ComfyUI/
├── models/
│ └── controlnet/
│ └── YOUR_CONTROLNET_MODEL.safetensors
│
└── custom_nodes/
└── comfyui_controlnet_aux/

After installation, restart ComfyUI and select the ControlNet model from theLoad ControlNet Modelnode.
